label: Package fails to load, HTTP 500
description: The service fails while putting the questionnaire package together and says so in an OperationOutcome. This is a finding about the environment, not about the member or the order. It models DTR 2.0.1, whose operation answers a failure with an OperationOutcome. The CRD test member ID P32H-ERR500 selects it too, so a case means the same thing in CRD and in DTR.
basis: Synthetic. Shaped to DTR 2.0.1, the version this tool is held to, from the guide's own examples where it has them, with this project's placeholders for every value the guide leaves open. It has not been observed from the live service.

details.text: The questionnaire package could not be assembled.

issue.diagnostics: The questionnaire package could not be assembled.
